general_topics.title: Why Reference Ranges Vary
general_topics.summary: Reference ranges are usually based on test results from large groups of healthy people. Different labs use different machines and methods, and ranges can also differ by age and sex. So the same sample can give slightly different numbers at different labs. Always compare your result with the range printed on your own report.

general_topics.title: What an 'Out of Range' Result Means
general_topics.summary: A result outside the printed range means it falls outside what is seen in most healthy people. It does not by itself mean something is wrong. Healthy people can sometimes have results outside the range, and things like recent exercise, fluid intake or illness can move a result for a short time. Your doctor looks at the result together with your symptoms, history and other tests.

general_topics.title: Fasting Before a Blood Test
general_topics.summary: Fasting means not eating or drinking anything except plain water for a set time before the test, often 8 to 12 hours. Food and drinks can temporarily change some results, such as blood sugar and fats. Follow the instructions you were given for your test, and ask your lab or doctor if you are unsure.

general_topics.title: When to Seek Urgent Medical Care
general_topics.summary: Lab results should never be judged on their own. If you notice severe symptoms, such as severe chest pain, trouble breathing, sudden confusion, loss of consciousness or bleeding that will not stop, get emergency help straight away by contacting your local emergency number or going to the nearest emergency department, whatever your lab numbers are.
general_topics.source_note: General safety statement with no source cited. Add a verified source (for example an official emergency-care page for your country) before publishing.

general_topics.title: Why a Doctor Must Interpret Results
general_topics.summary: Lab results are read together with your symptoms, medical history, examination and other tests. An app cannot see that full picture, so only a doctor can say what a result means for you and whether any follow-up is needed.

blood_tests.hindi_summary: क्रिएटिनिन (Creatinine) मांसपेशियों की सामान्य गतिविधि से बनने वाला एक अपशिष्ट पदार्थ है, जिसे गुर्दे खून से छानकर बाहर निकालते हैं। शरीर में पानी की मात्रा, मांसपेशियों की मात्रा और खान-पान से यह बदल सकता है। अपनी रिपोर्ट का मतलब समझने के लिए डॉक्टर से बात करें।

blood_tests.typical_range_info: 7-20. Ranges vary by lab, age, sex and method; always use the range printed on your own report.
blood_tests.clinical_summary: Urea (measured as blood urea nitrogen, or BUN) is a waste product made when the body breaks down protein. The kidneys remove it from the blood.
blood_tests.general_context_low: A value below the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including low protein intake or drinking a lot of fluid, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
blood_tests.general_context_high: A value above the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including dehydration or a high-protein diet, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
blood_tests.when_to_talk_to_a_doctor: Please discuss any result outside the range printed on your report with your doctor. Mention it sooner if you notice swelling or a big change in how much urine you pass.
questions_for_doctor: Could my diet or recent fluid intake explain this value?
How do you read this together with my creatinine?
Should this test be repeated?
blood_tests.hindi_summary: यूरिया या बीयूएन (Urea / BUN) प्रोटीन के टूटने से बनने वाला एक अपशिष्ट पदार्थ है। भोजन में प्रोटीन की मात्रा और शरीर में पानी के स्तर से यह बदल सकता है। अपनी रिपोर्ट का मतलब समझने के लिए डॉक्टर से बात करें।

blood_tests.typical_range_info: 7-56. Ranges vary by lab, age, sex and method; always use the range printed on your own report.
blood_tests.clinical_summary: ALT is an enzyme found mostly in the liver. Small amounts are normally present in the blood.
blood_tests.general_context_low: Low values are common and are usually not looked at closely.
blood_tests.general_context_high: A value above the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including strenuous exercise, alcohol use, or body weight, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
blood_tests.when_to_talk_to_a_doctor: Please discuss any result outside the range printed on your report with your doctor. ALT is usually read together with other liver tests. Mention it sooner if you notice yellowing of the skin or eyes, or dark urine.
questions_for_doctor: Could recent exercise or alcohol use explain this value?
How does this compare with my AST and other liver tests?
Should this be repeated after some time?
blood_tests.hindi_summary: एएलटी (ALT या SGPT) एक एंजाइम है जो मुख्य रूप से लिवर में पाया जाता है। कसरत, शराब और शरीर के वजन जैसी बातों से इसका स्तर बदल सकता है। अपनी रिपोर्ट का मतलब समझने के लिए डॉक्टर से बात करें।

blood_tests.typical_range_info: 8-33. Ranges vary by lab, age, sex and method; always use the range printed on your own report.
blood_tests.clinical_summary: AST is an enzyme found in the liver and also in muscles, including the heart.
blood_tests.general_context_low: Low values are common and are usually not looked at closely.
blood_tests.general_context_high: A value above the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including intense exercise or muscle strain, or alcohol use, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
blood_tests.when_to_talk_to_a_doctor: Please discuss any result outside the range printed on your report with your doctor. AST is usually read together with ALT and other liver tests. Mention it sooner if you notice yellowing of the skin or eyes, or dark urine.

blood_tests.hindi_summary: एएसटी (AST या SGOT) एक एंजाइम है जो लिवर के साथ-साथ मांसपेशियों में भी पाया जाता है। भारी कसरत या मांसपेशियों में खिंचाव से भी इसका स्तर बदल सकता है। अपनी रिपोर्ट का मतलब समझने के लिए डॉक्टर से बात करें।

blood_tests.typical_range_info: 0.2-1.2. Ranges vary by lab, age, sex and method; always use the range printed on your own report.
blood_tests.clinical_summary: Bilirubin is a yellowish substance made when old red blood cells break down. The liver processes it and it leaves the body in bile.
blood_tests.general_context_low: Low values are common and are usually not looked at closely.
blood_tests.general_context_high: A value above the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including fasting for a long time, differences you were born with in how the body handles bilirubin, or how quickly red blood cells break down, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
blood_tests.when_to_talk_to_a_doctor: Please discuss any result outside the range printed on your report with your doctor. Mention it sooner if you notice a yellow tint in your eyes or skin, or dark urine.
questions_for_doctor: Could fasting or an inherited difference in how my body handles bilirubin explain this?
Should the direct and indirect parts of bilirubin be checked?
How does this fit with my other liver tests and blood count?
blood_tests.hindi_summary: बिलीरुबिन (Bilirubin) पुरानी लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं के टूटने से बनने वाला एक पीला पदार्थ है। लंबे समय तक खाली पेट रहने जैसी बातों से भी इसका स्तर बदल सकता है। अपनी रिपोर्ट का मतलब समझने के लिए डॉक्टर से बात करें।

blood_tests.typical_range_info: 0.4-4.0. Ranges vary by lab, age, sex and method; always use the range printed on your own report.
blood_tests.clinical_summary: TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone) is made by a gland in the brain called the pituitary. It tells the thyroid gland how much thyroid hormone to make.
blood_tests.general_context_low: A value below the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including the time of day the sample was taken, or a recent illness, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
blood_tests.general_context_high: A value above the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including the time of day the sample was taken, or a recent illness, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
factors_that_can_affect_result: Time of day the sample was taken
blood_tests.when_to_talk_to_a_doctor: Please discuss any result outside the range printed on your report with your doctor. Doctors often check other thyroid tests together with TSH. Mention it sooner if you notice ongoing unexplained weight changes, feel unusually hot or cold, or notice lasting changes in your energy.

blood_tests.hindi_summary: टीएसएच (TSH) मस्तिष्क की एक ग्रंथि से बनने वाला हार्मोन है, जो थायरॉयड ग्रंथि को बताता है कि उसे कितना हार्मोन बनाना है। दिन का समय, हाल की बीमारी और गर्भावस्था जैसी बातों से इसका स्तर बदल सकता है। अपनी रिपोर्ट का मतलब समझने के लिए डॉक्टर से बात करें।

blood_tests.typical_range_info: 30-100. Ranges vary by lab, age, sex and method; always use the range printed on your own report.
blood_tests.clinical_summary: Vitamin D helps the body absorb calcium and supports bones and the immune system. The body makes it when skin is exposed to sunlight, and it also comes from some foods.
blood_tests.general_context_low: A value below the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including little sun exposure, diet, skin pigmentation, or how the body absorbs nutrients, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
blood_tests.general_context_high: A value above the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including a very high intake from products taken in addition to food, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
blood_tests.when_to_talk_to_a_doctor: Please discuss any result outside the range printed on your report with your doctor. Mention it sooner if you notice ongoing bone or muscle aches.
questions_for_doctor: Could my sun exposure or diet explain this level?
When should this test be repeated?
Does this level matter for my bones?
blood_tests.hindi_summary: विटामिन डी (Vitamin D) शरीर को कैल्शियम सोखने में मदद करता है और हड्डियों तथा रोग-प्रतिरोधक क्षमता के लिए जरूरी है। धूप में रहने की मात्रा, खान-पान और मौसम जैसी बातों से इसका स्तर बदल सकता है। अपनी रिपोर्ट का मतलब समझने के लिए डॉक्टर से बात करें।

blood_tests.typical_range_info: 200-900. Ranges vary by lab, age, sex and method; always use the range printed on your own report.
blood_tests.clinical_summary: Vitamin B12 helps the body make red blood cells and DNA, and supports the nerves.
blood_tests.general_context_low: A value below the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including a diet with little or no animal products, or how well the body absorbs B12, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
blood_tests.general_context_high: A value above the printed range can be associated with many different causes, including a very high intake from products taken in addition to food, or other reasons your doctor may look into.
factors_that_can_affect_result: How well the gut absorbs nutrients
blood_tests.when_to_talk_to_a_doctor: Please discuss any result outside the range printed on your report with your doctor. Mention it sooner if you notice ongoing tingling or numbness, or changes in memory or concentration.
questions_for_doctor: Could my diet explain this B12 level?
Do I need other tests, such as a blood count, alongside it?

blood_tests.hindi_summary: विटामिन बी12 (Vitamin B12) शरीर को लाल रक्त कोशिकाएं और डीएनए बनाने में मदद करता है और नसों के सही काम के लिए जरूरी है। खान-पान और शरीर के पोषक तत्व सोखने की क्षमता जैसी बातों से इसका स्तर बदल सकता है। अपनी रिपोर्ट का मतलब समझने के लिए डॉक्टर से बात करें।
